windows.setup: Extract the ZIP, run Install Gate Desk.cmd once, then open the desktop shortcut. In Account & Plans, choose Connect factory CCTV → Find my recorder. Runtime, dependencies and experimental bag model included.
windows.description: 2 November trial with owner-approved recorder discovery over the factory network. Software and packaged-app checks passed; actual recorder discovery, clean-PC use, phones and factory counting remain unverified. Not a final factory release.

macos.setup: Extract the ZIP. In Terminal, open its folder and run sh "./Check This Mac.command". Python, dependencies and the experimental bag model are included. This checks compatibility; it does not install the app.
macos.description: 2 November Apple-silicon package includes the new recorder-discovery code. Dependencies require macOS 14 or later. Native installation, network permissions, model execution and phone TLS remain unverified. Not a factory installer.

android.setup: Install the APK, open Gate Desk Dev, enter your factory HTTPS address, then tap Connect to factory and sign in. The factory phone service must be running and reachable.
android.description: Android 8 or later. Version 0.3-dev. This phone client connects to the factory host; the counting model runs on the computer. Physical-phone and off-site use remain unverified. APK files do not install on iPhone.
